en: Points of Controversy:
The Great Fifty-Section,
Chapter Twenty-three.
Discourse on Counterfeits:
Is there such a thing as that which resembles lust but is not lust?
Yes, there is.
There is that which is not contact but resembles contact;
there is that which is not feeling but resembles feeling;
there is that which is not perception but resembles perception.
There is that which is not volition but resembles volition;
there is that which is not consciousness but resembles consciousness;
there is that which is not faith but resembles faith.
There is energy that is a counterfeit of energy;
there is mindfulness that is a counterfeit of mindfulness;
there is concentration that is a counterfeit of concentration.
Is there that which is not wisdom but resembles wisdom?
One should not say so… [and so on] … Is there that which is not hatred but resembles hatred? One should not say so… [and so on].
Is there that which is not delusion but resembles delusion,
and that which is not a defilement but resembles a defilement?
Yes, there is.
Is there that which is not contact but resembles contact?
…pe… Is there that which is not wisdom but resembles wisdom?
One should certainly not say so …pe….
The Discussion on the Corresponding has been concluded.
